items.scope: Vulnerabilities discovered by SRA that are not within the scope of another CNA.
JetBrains products only.

Vulnerabilities that are discovered, validated, and coordinated through the Hackrate Ethical Hacking Platform, including: software, web applications, APIs, and cloud services; vulnerabilities validated and triaged by our internal security team; and findings disclosed under our coordination that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Kaspersky B2C and B2B products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered in third-party software not in another CNA’s scope.
NVIDIA issues only.
Vulnerabilities in software discovered by DIVD, and vulnerabilities reported to DIVD for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
Dell, Dell EMC, and VCE issues only.
openHarmony issues only.
All Vaadin products and supported open source projects hosted at https://github.com/vaadin.
All SAP products.
All Omnissa products and services, including Workspace ONE and Horizon.
Forcepoint products only.
All Mattermost issues, and vulnerabilities discovered by Mattermost that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All EnterpriseDB products and vulnerabilities identified in open source libraries used by EnterpriseDB products unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
Adobe issues only.
Vulnerabilities in the following Altium products only: Altium Designer, A365, Octopart, and Altium Enterprise Server.
Zyxel products issues only.
Vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Bombadil Systems that are not in another CNA’s scope.
SoftIron HyperCloud branded products and technologies only.
All HYPR products only.
All HiddenLayer systems, services, and products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by HiddenLayer that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Products and projects covered by its bug bounty programs that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in supported Ivanti products and infrastructure, excluding third-party components, and meeting severity thresholds defined in Ivanti’s Disclosure Policy found here.
Vulnerabilities discovered by researchers in collaboration with Maritime Hacking Village that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All ConnectWise products and services and vulnerabilities discovered by ConnectWise in third party products that are not within another CNA’s scope.

All CyberDanube products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party hardware/software discovered by CyberDanube or partners actively engaged in vulnerability research coordination, which are not within the scope of another CNA.
Vulnerabilities in runZero products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, runZero that are not in another CNA’s scope.

All BeyondTrust products, including PasswordSafe, Privileged Remote Access, Remote Support, Privilege Management for Windows/Mac, Privilege Management for Unix/Linux, Identity Security Insights, Active Directory (AD) Bridge, and Total PASM.
All Honeywell products.
Concrete CMS Core versions 8.5 and above.
Genetec products and solutions only.
PaperCut MF, PaperCut NG, PaperCut Hive, PaperCut Pocket, PaperCut Mobility Print, QRdoc, PaperCut Views, PaperCut Multiverse, https://www.papercut.com, and all other PaperCut products and services.
Vulnerabilities in Commvault SaaS and software products only.
Vivo issues only.
Vulnerabilities in PHP code (code in https://github.com/php/php-src) only.
Supported Secomea products only.
All Schneider Electric products, including Proface, APC, and ProLeiT.
Yugabyte products only.
Caliptra Project components and vulnerabilities that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Projects listed on its Alibaba GitHub website only.
Pandora FMS, Pandora ITSM, and Pandora RC issues only.

Vulnerabilities in software, services, and infrastructure owned and managed by Spartans Security, and vulnerabilities researched and found by Spartans Security in third-party products that are not part of another CNA's scope.
GitHub Enterprise Server issues only.
Vulnerabilities identified in Cribl products, and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Cribl that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All ESET products only and vulnerabilities discovered by ESET that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
All rami.io GmbH products and open source projects, including pretix, official pretix plugins and apps, and Venueless.
Vulnerabilities in OpenAI installed software including desktop apps, mobile apps, and SDKs only.
openGauss issues only.
Vulnerabilities in any Google Cloud developed product and not under the scope of another CNA.
Teltonika Networks products and services only.
